component.name: Vibe Typer
component.summary: Speech to text in any app

description.p: Press a hotkey, speak, and clean, punctuated text is typed at your cursor in any app, terminals and code editors included. No window to copy from and no per-app setup.
Magic Formatter, our own model built just for cleaning up dictation, tidies what you said once you stop talking, so ums, repeats and spoken corrections like "scratch that" never reach the page.

ul.li: Speech to text in 99 languages, with automatic detection
Paragraphs and lists from how you talk, plus tone presets
A dictionary that learns from your corrections
Rewrite or reply to selected text by voice
Voice typing on Wayland and X11, including GNOME and KDE Plasma
Also on Windows, Mac and iPhone

description.p: Sign up free, no card needed: every feature, with 2,000 words and 20 AI rewrites or replies a month. Pro removes both limits. Audio is processed in the cloud, in memory, and not stored on our servers.
